author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica / maitespena
title: Seeking illustrators for book character art
content: 🚨Se buscan ilustradores 📢 Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. (All characters are adults, some non-human like demons and magical beings. Adult novel with humor, seeking colorful and simple style.)

title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too! #FantasyIllustration #BookCoverArtist #YAFantasy
